contract.milestonesAreIndependent: monotonicFunnel and unionFunnels keep each boolean as observed. OR across duplicate rows does not fill an earlier step. Focus does not prove the form was visible. contract.diagnosticRates: formVisiblePerExposed, formFocusedPerExposed, and submitAttemptedPerExposed each divide that observed stage by exposed sessions. They are not conditional on the previous stage, so they do not chain and they do not hide a later stage when an earlier one is missing.

report.auth: WATCHDIVE_EXPERIMENT_REPORT_TOKEN trimmed length must be at least 32. Authorization is compared as sha256(header) versus sha256('Bearer ' + secret) with timingSafeEqual. Failure is 401 { error: 'unauthorized' } with Cache-Control: private, no-store, max-age=0 before any Notion client or query.
report.body: Aggregates, generatedAt, quality gaps, and caveats. No email, session id, page id, IP, or click id.
report.denominator: Consented sessions whose stored funnel has exposed true. Nonconsent sessions are not written and are not backfilled. QA sessions and QA leads are excluded. Inconsistent variant or team across duplicate rows is excluded. Duplicate rows are one session: earliest assignedAt, OR of observed flags.
report.counts: newEmails is the raw count of distinct canonical emails that match an eligible exposure and were saved inside 48 hours. sessionsWithNewEmail and sessionsWithVerifiedEmail are distinct sessions. Two emails on one session increment newEmails by 2 and sessionsWithNewEmail by 1. Primary visit conversion is rates.newEmailSessionsPerSession.
report.mature: A session is mature when now - earliest assignedAt is at least 48 hours. Verified counts only when verifiedAt is inside 48 hours of that exposure, verifiedAt is not before signedUp beyond 2 minutes of clock skew, and neither timestamp is more than 10 minutes in the future. rates.matureNewEmailPerSession and rates.matureVerifiedEmailPerSession use distinct mature sessions. rates.savedEmailSessionsPerSession is the immature cohort only and is descriptive.

decision.matureCohortAvailable: true only when both reads finished, the column is present, nothing was truncated, and matureSessions > 0. Ongoing traffic does not turn this off. It is not a statistical result.

report.unavailable: Missing config, a failed read, or a missing Conversion experiment column sets the affected counts to null and complete to false. A true zero is only after a successful read of a present source.
report.identity: A lead with no canonical email and no email title is malformed and excluded. It is not given a synthetic untagged key.
report.noCpa: Both variants share the same ads after the click. The report does not compute CPA.
report.balance: 50:50 is the assignment expectation inside each paid team. A finite sample is not exactly balanced.
